verdict.rationale: Morph's docs publish concrete per-component speed figures: Fast Apply at 10,500 tok/s with 98% accuracy, Compact at 33,000 tok/s, morph-v3-fast at 10,500+ tok/s, and Reflex classifiers at ~90ms per turn. Its GitHub demos also cite 4,500+ tok/s. That meets the story's core of published tokens-per-second and latency numbers, but these are bare vendor claims rather than documented benchmarks. Missing for 10: benchmark methodology or reproducible benchmark results, a load-testing guide, latency/throughput numbers for the open-weight chat models (e.g., Kimi K3), and independent corroboration of the figures.
